Subject: Billing bank change + new warehouse remit contact

Hi Diego,

Quick note from Harbor Logistics — we are changing our billing account for ACH/Wire effective 2027-06-30. Attached: a signed bank change letter and our updated W-9.

Please also update our remit contact for warehouse shipment invoices to Samantha Li (s.li@harborlogistics.com, +1-415-555-0182). She will handle all Ship-To invoice reconciliation and will be the point of contact for PO/ASN exceptions.

High-level details:
- Old bank: First National Bank — routing 111000025 (closing 06/30)
- New bank: Meridian Trust — routing 222000047 — account ending 7342
- Effective date: 2027-07-01 for remits
- Requested PO behavior: keep PO numbers on line-item level (ShipTo field) for warehouse remits

Attachments:
- Harbor_Bank_Change_Letter_20270615.pdf (signed)
- Updated_W9_20270615.pdf

Can you confirm what additional verification AP needs from our side? We can provide a voided check or bank confirmation letter from the bank if required.

Thanks,
Luis Ortega
Director, Finance Operations
Harbor Logistics, Inc.

Date: 2027-06-15T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing bank change + new warehouse remit contact

Thanks Luis — received. A few quick items to help us process this without payment delays:

1) AP verification: please upload the signed bank letter and a copy/photo of a voided check to our vendor portal record (link below) OR reply to this thread with the voided check image. We typically require either a voided check or bank-attested confirmation for ACH changes.

2) Remit contact: we'll update Samantha as the warehouse remit contact, but confirm whether she should be the billing contact for all invoices or only Ship-To invoices from your warehouses.

3) PO routing: for any open POs currently in flight that should be routed to the warehouse remit, please list the PO numbers or confirm that your team will invoice with ShipTo field populated so automated routing picks them up.

Portal link for uploads: https://vendor-portal.redwood.example/records/HL-7892
AP policy: if documents arrive by 2027-06-18 we can queue the change for the 07/05 payment run; otherwise it will process on the following cycle.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looping in Monica (AP) and Karthik (Procurement) to coordinate the update.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
[diego signature]
